# Municipal Ordinance No. 08, Series of 1996

**Municipal Ordinance No.08**

## Summary

Municipal Ordinance No. 08, Series of [[1996]], enacted by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of [[Municipality of Pitogo|Pitogo]], Quezon on October 28, 1996. This ordinance regulates the keeping of dogs within the town proper and for other purposes. It establishes policies to protect residents from rabid dog bites and to provide proper care for health and safety against waste from dogs in thoroughfares and public places.

## Key Provisions

- **Section 1 (Declaration of Policy)** — It is the policy of the present local administration that the keeping of dogs within the town proper be regulated to protect residents from rabid bites and to provide proper care for health and safety resulting from waste of said animals in thoroughfares and public places.
- **Section 2 (Unlawful Acts)** — For owners of dogs, the following shall be unlawful:
  - (a) It shall be unlawful to keep a dog or number of dogs without securing a license or permit and paying the required fee of One Hundred Pesos (P100.00) for each dog.
  - (b) It shall be unlawful to let or allow a dog or group of dogs to roam freely within the town proper.
  - (c) It shall be unlawful to let or allow a dog or group of dogs to urinate or excrete their waste in public places or thoroughfares, even though said animals are with leash such as chains, ropes, or cords.
- **Section 3 (Penalty)** — Any person or persons found violating this ordinance shall pay a fine of Fifty Pesos (P50.00) for the first offense, and for the second offense, immediate impounding of the dog or dogs to be sold at public auction after forty-eight (48) hours.
- **Section 4 (Repealing Clause)** — Any ordinance or part of an ordinance inconsistent with the provisions of this ordinance is hereby repealed.
- **Section 5 (Effectivity)** — This ordinance shall take effect upon approval.

### Penalty Summary
| Offense | Penalty |
|---------|---------|
| First | P50.00 fine |
| Second | Impounding and public auction after 48 hours |
